pageIntro: Pick a formative practice band for a portfolio using your school rubric. Teacher / coordinator coaching only — never presented as an HKEAA result.
disclaimer: Not official. Not an HKEAA / public-exam result. These “practice / performance-reference” bands are for school-internal formative discussion only. Formal SBA marks follow the HKEAA Teachers’ Handbook and moderation. Do not upload student 5** exemplars to the public app.

bandPicker.title: Practice band (performance reference)
bandPicker.help: Soft four-step scale for in-school coaching. Do not label options as official “5** / public-exam grades”.
bandPicker.schoolMappingNote: Coordinators may map these practice bands to school house bands / descriptors. Mapping is school-owned; the app does not preset official grades.

criteria.rowsHelp: Aligned to public criterion names (1 workbook + 4 pieces / 4 + 6 criteria). Labels are placeholders — fill level text from your school rubric.

teacherTips.text: Fill against your school / panel rubric first; this page is only a practice-band skeleton.
Do not present these bands to students or parents as HKEAA / official SBA marks.
Do not publish student 5** or high-score work in the public app; keep samples school-permission only.
Bands are school formative / coaching reference — mappable to house bands, not a submitted mark.
Student path stays self-rating 1–4 / text feedback; do not sync teacher draft bands as student “scores”.
